lines: // Greets every player who joins and points them at the ruby ore trick.
e.player.sendMessage("Welcome, " + e.player.name + "! Sneak and use ruby ore for a bonus ruby.");

meta.notes: A script that handles the player.join event: it sends the joining player a chat message and writes a line to the server log ([msm_runtime] msm_starter:welcome: <name> joined). Server log lines from scripts are the quickest way to see that they loaded and ran. Scripts run only in the Fabric mod jar export, with msm_runtime; the vanilla packs and the Java project export leave them out.
